# SpeakLab

> SpeakLab (also written "Speak Lab" or "SpeakLab by Shayan") is an 8-week Communication and Confidence Program based in Lahore, Pakistan. It is not a language school — the subject is confidence and communication, and English is the medium of instruction.

## What is SpeakLab?

SpeakLab helps Pakistani students and young professionals speak up with confidence — in interviews, presentations, meetings and everyday conversation — through a structured 8-week program. Sessions are conducted in English with Urdu support whenever a student needs it. Classes are held in-person at Punjab Tianjin University of Technology, Lahore, with small batches for maximum personal attention.

## Free Trial Classes

Not sure yet? SpeakLab offers Free Trial Classes: attend 3 full sessions at no cost and with no obligation before deciding to enroll. You join a real running batch, meet the instructor, and only pay if you continue.
Book: https://www.speaklabbyshayan.com/trial-classes.html

## Program Details

- Duration: 8 weeks, 24 total sessions
- Sessions: Tuesday, Thursday & Saturday, 6:00 PM – 7:30 PM
- Location: Punjab Tianjin University of Technology, Lahore
- Batch size: Maximum 20 students (limited seats)
- Price: PKR 20,000 total — PKR 10,000 advance confirms your seat; remaining PKR 10,000 payable before the batch starts
- Certificate: Yes, SpeakLab Certificate of Completion awarded on finishing
- Language of Instruction: English (Urdu support available)

## Curriculum

- Fearless Speaking: Break the hesitation that stops you mid-sentence and speak up in any situation
- Public Speaking & Confidence: Overcome stage fright and build unshakeable self-belief
- Professional Communication: Soft skills and business etiquette for the corporate world
- Interview Preparation: Hands-on practice to ace job interviews
- Critical Thinking & Expression: Think on your feet and respond intelligently

## Who is it for?

- University students who go quiet in class and presentations
- Fresh graduates preparing for job interviews
- Working professionals who want to be heard in meetings
- Anyone who knows English grammar but freezes when actually speaking

## Instructor

Sir Shayan — an experienced communication and confidence coach passionate about helping students unlock their true potential. His dynamic teaching style combines theory with real-world practice.
